# AgentOps Monitor - Complete System Context & Documentation (agentopsmonitor.com)
> Observability, telemetry, distributed tracing, and security monitoring for multi-agent systems and LLM pipelines.

This document contains comprehensive architecture, technical specifications, and API documentation for LLMs, AI agents, and automated crawlers querying AgentOps Monitor.

---

## 1. Platform Overview
AgentOps Monitor (https://agentopsmonitor.com) is an observability and reliability platform engineered specifically for autonomous agent networks, multi-agent frameworks, and complex LLM architectures.

### Core Problems Solved
- Invisible Cascading Failures: Multi-agent loops where subagents hallucinate or get stuck in recursive execution cycles.
- Token Runaways and Budget Exhaustion: Unchecked tool calls causing sudden cost spikes across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or local models.
- Tool Call Failures: Silent errors in API calls, malformed parameters, or unhandled exceptions in agent toolchains.
- Security and Policy Breaches: Prompt injection, unauthorized data exfiltration, and tool execution outside defined boundary policies.

---

## 2. Core Architecture & Features

### 2.1 Distributed Multi-Agent Tracing
- OpenTelemetry (OTLP) compatible trace collector.
- Visual execution graph showing parent agents, subagents, tool invocations, and LLM reasoning steps.
- Sub-millisecond trace ingestion pipeline with end-to-end latency profiling.
- Support for asynchronous agent communication patterns (pub/sub, direct message, blackboard).

### 2.2 Cost and Token Analytics
- Real-time tracking of input tokens, output tokens, cached tokens, and reasoning tokens.
- Cost attribution grouped by agent role, model provider, prompt template, user ID, or organization workspace.
- Configurable circuit breakers: automatically pause agents or abort runs when token or spend thresholds are reached.

### 2.3 Agent Security Guardrails
- Input/Output scanner for prompt injections, jailbreaks, and sensitive data leakage (PII/credentials).
- Tool authorization policies restricting execution of sensitive operations based on agent identity and session state.
- Automated killswitches triggered by anomalous behavior or repeated validation failures.

### 2.4 Framework & SDK Ecosystem
AgentOps Monitor provides zero-overhead SDKs and integrations for:
- Python: `pip install agentops-monitor`
- Node.js / TypeScript: `npm install @agentops/monitor`
- Native connectors: LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, OpenAI Swarm.

---

## 3. Quick Start & Integration Guides

### Python Integration
```python
import agentops_monitor

# Initialize tracking at application startup
agentops_monitor.init(
    api_key="aom_live_...",
    project="customer-support-swarm",
    environment="production"
)

# Automatic instrumentation wraps popular frameworks
from langchain.chat_models import ChatOpenAI
llm = ChatOpenAI(model="gpt-4o")
```

### TypeScript / Node.js Integration
```typescript
import { initAgentOps } from "@agentops/monitor";

const monitor = initAgentOps({
  apiKey: process.env.AGENTOPS_API_KEY,
  projectName: "data-analysis-agent",
  environment: "production",
});

// Trace an agent execution session
const session = monitor.startSession({
  agentId: "analyst-01",
  sessionId: "sess-98213",
});
```

---

## 4. REST API Reference

All requests to the ingestion API require the `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>` header.

### Endpoints
- `POST https://agentopsmonitor.com/api/ingest`
  - Ingest raw spans, execution traces, and event payloads.
  - Body: JSON payload matching the OpenTelemetry span format or native AgentOps schema.
- `GET https://agentopsmonitor.com/api/health`
  - Returns service health and uptime status.
- `GET https://agentopsmonitor.com/api/status`
  - Returns current ingestion latency and pipeline metrics.
